cards.ex: The scandal hit the headlines and everyone was talking about it.
cards.exUz: Bu janjal sarlavhalarga chiqdi va hamma bu haqda gapirardi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarida katta voqea sifatida yoritilmoq, mashhur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The journalist cited a reliable source within the government.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist hukumatdagi ishonchli manbaga murojaat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga yaqin ma'lumot beradigan, yolg'on so'zlamaydigan odam yoki tashkilot.

cards.ex: The politician tried to spin the story to make himself look good.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi voqeani o'zini yaxshi ko'rsatish uchun talqin qilishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani o'z foydasiga moslab, noto'g'ri yoki bo'rttirib yoritish.

cards.ex: The reporter managed to get the scoop on the celebrity's divorce.
cards.exUz: Reportyor mashhurning ajrashishi haqida birinchi bo'lib xabar olishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi bo'lib muhim yangilik yoki ma'lumotni olish.

cards.ex: The video went viral within hours of being posted.
cards.exUz: Video joylashtirilganidan so'ng bir necha soat ichida tarqalib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Internetda juda tez va keng tarqalmoq.

cards.ex: A lot of hard work goes on behind the scenes to produce a news program.
cards.exUz: Yangiliklar dasturini ishlab chiqarish uchun sahna ortida ko'p mehnat qilinadi.
cards.uzDef: Ommaga ko'rinmaydigan, yashirin holda qilinadigan ishlar.

cards.ex: The newspaper was accused of yellow journalism for its sensationalist headlines.
cards.exUz: Gazeta sensatsion sarlavhalari uchun sariq matbuotda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Sensatsiyaga urg'u beradigan, ishonchsiz va bo'rttirilgan xabarlar.

cards.ex: The story was reported by several major media outlets.
cards.exUz: Bu voqea bir nechta yirik ommaviy axborot vositalari tomonidan xabar qilingan.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklar va axborotni tarqatadigan tashkilot (gazeta, televideniye, radio, internet).

cards.ex: The magazine has a clear editorial policy on environmental issues.
cards.exUz: Jurnalning atrof-muhit masalalari bo'yicha aniq tahrir siyosati bor.
cards.uzDef: Nashriyotning maqolalar va xabarlarni tanlash va yoritish bo'yicha yo'nalishi.

cards.ex: All articles undergo fact-checking before publication.
cards.exUz: Barcha maqolalar nashr etilishidan oldin faktlarni tekshirishdan o'tadi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotlarning haqiqiyligini tekshirish jarayoni.

cards.ex: The reporter buried the lead, so the article wasn't very impactful.
cards.exUz: Reportyor asosiy ma'lumotni yashirdi, shuning uchun maqola unchalik ta'sirli bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhim ma'lumotni maqolaning oxiriga yaqin joylashtirmoq.

cards.ex: The scandal dominated the news cycle for weeks.
cards.exUz: Bu janjal bir necha hafta davomida yangiliklar davrida hukmronlik qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yangiliklar tarqalishi, muhokama qilinishi va eskirishi davri.

cards.ex: The politician's sound bite was replayed on every news channel.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining qisqa lavhasi har bir yangiliklar kanalida qayta efirga uzatildi.
cards.uzDef: Intervyuning qisqa, ta'sirli parchasi.

cards.ex: The source spoke on the record, so we can quote them directly.
cards.exUz: Manba rasmiy ravishda gapirdi, shuning uchun biz ulardan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri iqtibos keltira olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumot shunday deb e'lon qilinadi va uning manbai ko'rsatiladi.

cards.ex: The official spoke off the record about the sensitive issue.
cards.exUz: Rasmiy shaxs nozik masala haqida norasmiy ravishda gapirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni nashr qilmang yoki manbani ko'rsatmang, degan shart bilan.

cards.ex: The police relied on eyewitness accounts to reconstruct the crime.
cards.exUz: Politsiya jinoyatni qayta tiklash uchun ko'rgan guvohlarning guvohliklariga tayandi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani ko'rgan odamning hikoyasi.

cards.ex: Freedom of the press is essential for a democratic society.
cards.exUz: Matbuot erkinligi demokratik jamiyat uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: Ommaviy axborot vositalarining hukumat aralashuvisiz axborot tarqatish huquqi.

cards.ex: Investigative journalism played a key role in uncovering the scandal.
cards.exUz: Surishtiruv jurnalistikasi bu janjalni ochishda muhim rol o'ynadi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim masalalarni chuqur o'rganish va oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: The media often sensationalizes stories to attract more viewers.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari ko'proq tomoshabinlarni jalb qilish uchun ko'pincha voqealarni sensatsiya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Voqeani qiziqarliroq qilish uchun bo'rttirib yoritish.

cards.ex: The study was criticized for being a biased report funded by the industry.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot sanoat tomonidan moliyalashtirilgan g'arazli hisobot ekanligi uchun tanqid qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Bir tarafni afzal ko'ruvchi, xolis bo'lmagan xabar.

cards.ex: The speaker struggled to get her point across to the audience.
cards.exUz: Notiq o'z fikrini tinglovchilarga tushuntirishga qiynaldi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani odamlarga tushunarli qilib yetkazish.

cards.ex: The journalist called out the politician for his misleading statements.
cards.exUz: Jurnalist siyosatchini noto'g'ri bayonotlari uchun fosh qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri yoki qabul qilib bo'lmaydigan xatti-harakatni tanqid qilmoq.

cards.ex: Don't fall for fake news on social media.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarda soxta yangiliklarga aldanib qolmang.
cards.uzDef: Soxta xabarlarga yoki firibgarlikka ishonib qolmoq.

cards.ex: The article drew attention to the plight of refugees.
cards.exUz: Maqola qochqinlarning ahvoliga diqqatni jalb qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga odamlarning diqqatini qaratish.

cards.ex: The media often jumps to conclusions before all the facts are known.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari ko'pincha barcha faktlar ma'lum bo'lmasdan xulosa chiqarishga shoshiladi.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni to'liq ko'rib chiqmasdan xulosa chiqarish.

cards.ex: We need to get the word out about the upcoming event.
cards.exUz: Biz bo'lajak tadbir haqida xabar tarqatishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'proq odamlarga biror narsa haqida ma'lumot bermoq.

cards.ex: The politician's silence only fueled speculation about his resignation.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining sukuti faqat uning iste'foga chiqishi haqidagi taxminlarni kuchaytirdi.
cards.uzDef: G'iybat yoki taxminlarning tarqalishiga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: There may be a grain of truth in the rumour, but it's mostly false.
cards.exUz: Mish-mishda haqiqat urug'i bo'lishi mumkin, lekin asosan yolg'on.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ma'lumotda ozgina haqiqat bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The media plays a crucial role in holding politicians accountable.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari siyosatchilarni javobgarlikka tortishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar uchun javob berishga majburlamoq.

cards.ex: The editorial board decides which issues to cover.
cards.exUz: Tahrir hay'ati qaysi masalalarni yoritishni hal qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Gazeta yoki jurnalning siyosatini belgilaydigan odamlar guruhi.
